data.one_liner: Extensible logging for Dart and Flutter based on the Android Timber library.
data.what_it_does: Fimber provides extensible and structured logging for Dart and Flutter applications. It mimics the Android Timber library API by utilizing concepts like trees and planting logging trees to output debug, verbose, info, warn, and error messages.
use_when: You want structured logging with support for custom trees, tags, and formatting.
You are familiar with the Timber logging concept from Android.
avoid_when: You need heavy remote crash reporting or analytics solutions out of the box without custom integration.
strengths: Supports multiple log levels and colorized log output via ANSI styles.
Allows custom log line formatters using tokens.
weaknesses: File logging functionality has been moved to a separate package (`fimber_io`).
Auto-tag generation from stack traces can add a slight performance cost if overused.
data.setup_notes: Plant a logging tree in your main function before using Fimber.
